title: Vibecoding a 3d game, objects also made in code - no assets used.
author: ResenhaDoBar
selftext:
Using Jabali game editor and Claude 4.5 Opus as agent.

I guess you can say there is 1 asset which is the sand texture, which was also generated inside Jabali.

comments.author: TopTippityTop
comments.body: How long would you say it took you to get it to this point?

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: Made that project in a day, worked on it for about 5 hours

replies.author: TopTippityTop
replies.body: That's kickass... Good job for a day!

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: Thank you!

replies.author: CryptoCatatonic
replies.body: you made this in a day? you should be making a tutorial on how you did this.

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: I actually captured footage of the entire process, will finish editing and will post on Youtube, I can make a new post when the video is live

replies.author: CryptoCatatonic
replies.body: thx, I look forward to that

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body:
Super cool! Efficacy looks pretty good too! Id suggest if you haven't already look at what the devs of Doom did to optimize efficiency! 

Whats the size of your project file? I have a pretty big project and its only at like 100-200 mpbs I bet through this method of asset storage its gotta be super small! very curious in what the difference in storage size is!

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body:
I'll check it out! Do you have a video for reference?

I can't tell you directly what's the size of the whole packaged thing yet since it's in a platform and not published yet, but adding up all the files and dependencies it's roughly 1-2mb in size

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: I can't find the organic video I watched but there are a ton of really good videos on how they designed their systems and creative ways they optimized it and how others have pushed it even farther since its release, I just think it would be helpful to get the ideas flowing for ya as I like to see whats been done and try to improve from there as a starting point

replies.author: outerdead
replies.body: I guess we are wondering if it managed to end up making that passable vehicle (in code) all by itself or did you have to go in and massage things to get the proportions right.

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar

comments.author: BurningRome
comments.body: Just a heads-up: I went to the Jabali website and noticed that my CPU spiked to 70%. Maybe it's poorly implemented, maybe there is a crypto miner in the background, maybe just a me problem: in any case people should be careful.

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: Hey! I’ve been using the studio which is downloadable so I haven’t noticed this, I’ll talk to the team about this, it’s definetly an optimization issue.

replies.author: NotDennis2
replies.body: What team, chatgpt?

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: The team from Jabali

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: Yo do you mind shooting me a DM? Would like to understand better what's up with the wesbite

replies.author: BurningRome
replies.body:
Sorry, I deactivated DMs due to bot spam.
All I can say is that there is *way too* much JavaScript processes running. Check the Performance tab in Firefox or Chrome-based browsers and let it run for a few seconds. You'll get something like this: [image.png](https://postimg.cc/TybycfGB)

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: Alright, appreciate the input on this, will escalate this to the devs, rest assured it’s not a miner :)

comments.author: deezymo
comments.body: Can you connect you claude max account to this or do you have to pay for their internal usage tokens ?

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: I don’t think you can connect your own Claude account for now, but since it’s on early access everything in the platform is free for now, so it’s great for testing out

replies.author: deezymo
replies.body: Got it bro thanks, would definitely give it a try, can you actually do everything from scratch or do the editor compells you to make the game under a specific workflow they built ? Im using godot + vs code + claude right now and this new editor seems nice for games but im curious about the potential downsides

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body:
You can start from scratch, for example when you start a project, the AI prompts you to choose one of the starting templates, but there is no threeJs template currently, what I did was use a phaser template and just told the AI to replace everything with a threeJs empty scene and it worked.

In your case it’s even easier, since godot is supported out of the box there. I’m always around in the Discord as well helping new members out.
